provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Swatara (Dauphin County), Chapter 295 Zoning (Zoning Ordinance of 2010, Ord. No. 2010-1, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: Chapter 295 adopted 7-27-2010 by Ord. No. 2010-1. 295-96 (accessory uses, including the accessory apartment standards) was amended 6-12-2024 (Ord. 2024-01), 5-14-2025 (Ord. 2025-03) and 8-5-2026 (Ord. 2026-05). The online text reflects them. 295-85.1 (non-owner short-term rentals) was added 5-14-2025. eCode360 New Laws (read 2026-11-13) list only Ord. 2026-07 (insurance claims for fires) and two airport maps. Code SW2044 is the Dauphin County township, not Swatara Township in Lebanon County.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Date carried from the towns index. The print view read on 2026-11-13 shows amendments to 8-5-2026 (Ord. 2026-05) and no currency line.
checks: An 'Accessory apartment' is a permitted accessory use by right in every district in the use tables (C, A, R-S, R-M and R-ML, A-OG, C-L, C-G, C-H, M-L, M-G), and in MU areas developed under R-M, C-L or M-L rules. A zoning permit is needed (295-28, 295-34D, 295-96D(1))

Only on a single-family detached lot, one apartment per lot. It may be inside, attached or detached. The definition speaks of a unit 'in or added to an existing single-family detached dwelling', while 295-96D(1)(b) says 'The apartment may be detached or attached to the primary residence'. Ask whether a new house and a unit may be built together (295-22, 295-96D(1)(b))
Size: at least 300 sq ft and no more than 45% of the house's total floor area (295-96D(1)(f))
Own exterior entry, not on the front of the house. Matching style. Meets the district building setbacks and coverage. A detached unit 10 ft from the house (295-96D(1)(a), (c), (d))
Parking: at least 3 off-street spaces in total for the owner-occupant and the tenant (295-96D(1)(g))
The ordinance does not say in so many words that the owner must live there. 295-96D(1)(g) speaks of 'the owner-occupant and tenant'. Ask the zoning officer

On a lot under 3 acres, a structure accessory to a dwelling may be one story plus a half story of nonhabitable storage, or 20 ft, whichever is less. A unit over a garage is read as not possible on such a lot (295-29B(1))
Not subdivided or sold apart from the house. With an on-lot septic system, a sewage permit first (295-96D(1)(h), (i))
Short-term rentals (owner-occupied or not) are allowed only in an existing residential building and 'Addition of new rental units on the property is prohibited' (295-85.1A, 295-96D(9.1))
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Swatara Township Community Development (Dauphin County). Districts (295-23): C, A, R-S, R-ML, R-M, A-OG, C-L, C-G, C-H, M-L, M-G, MU, AP overlay. MU areas are developed under R-M, C-L or M-L rules (295-34D). Read on eCode360 in a browser, the chapter print view, searched in the page, and the dimensional attachment (Attachment 2) page by page. Searched for accessory apartment, accessory dwelling, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, carriage, second dwelling, guest house, caretaker, conversion, tiny, short-term, two-family, family member, care of relative. 295-125 mentions 'a unit for care of relative' in a setback rule, but no such use is defined or listed. No historic district in the zoning chapter (historic text is in the wireless rules only).

term.note: 'A second dwelling unit either in or added to an existing single-family detached dwelling for use as a complete, independent living facility with provision within the accessory apartment for cooking, eating, sanitation and sleeping. Such a dwelling is an accessory use to the main dwelling.'

status.note: Use tables, Accessory Uses: 'Accessory apartment (§ 295-96) P P P P P' under C, A, R-S, R-M and R-ML, A-OG, and 'P P P' under C-L, C-G and C-H, M-L and M-G.

path.note: P means permitted by right with a zoning permit, if 295-96D(1) is met.

fallback_path.note: A unit that fails 295-96D(1) (for example a second apartment, or one over 45% of the house) needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. 295-7B (uses not regulated) does not reach it, since the use is listed.

value.name: Conversion of an existing building into two units
value.conditions: Permitted use (only 2 dwelling units in a building). The house keeps the look of a one-family dwelling with one front entrance. The lot and building must meet the rules for a new apartment building, including lot area: an average of 2,800 sq ft per unit. Parking for all units without credit for an old shortfall.

value.name: Conversion of an existing building into two units
value.conditions: Permitted use (only 2 dwelling units in a building). Keeps the look of a one-family dwelling. Meets the rules for a new apartment building: an average of 2,500 sq ft per unit.

value.name: Conversion of an existing building into more dwelling units
value.conditions: Permitted use in the commercial use table. Meets 295-56 and the district lot rules (20,000 sq ft).
value.note: The commercial table row reads 'P P N' under C-L, C-G and C-H, M-L and M-G.

alternatives.note: Not ADUs. The conversion row in the residential table: 'Only 2 dwelling units in a building N N N P P' under C, A, R-S, R-M and R-ML, A-OG. The apartment or two-family detached row is the same for new buildings.

zoning_districts.note: Accessory apartment P in every column of both use tables. Single-family detached dwellings are N in M-L and M-G, so there only an existing house could have one. MU is included because its areas are developed under the R-M, C-L or M-L rules, all of which list the apartment: 'If a use is not allowed in one of those three districts, it shall not be allowed in the MU District' (295-34D).

building_types.note: 'Only one accessory apartment shall be permitted per single-family detached residential lot.'

existing_structure_only.note: The definition says 'an existing single-family detached dwelling'. The standards allow a detached unit. No rule that the unit's building already exists. Whether the house must exist first is not settled.

historic_bypass.note: No historic district in the zoning chapter.

value.condition: The apartment has its own exterior entryway, not part of the front facade of the house, and conforms to the house's architectural style.

On a lot under 3 acres a structure accessory to a dwelling may be one story plus a half story limited to nonhabitable storage, or 20 ft. A unit above a garage needs a habitable upper story, so it is read as possible only on a lot of 3 acres or more.
With an on-lot sewage system, a sewage permit from the Township Sewage Enforcement Officer before the building permit.
On a lawful nonconforming lot of record, a single permitted principal use and its customary accessory uses may be built if setbacks are met. The apartment is an accessory use.

gates.note: Conditions from the accessory apartment standards.

types_allowed.note: 'The apartment may be detached or attached to the primary residence.' A unit inside the house fits 'in ... an existing single-family detached dwelling'. A garage conversion is read as a detached unit. Over a garage is limited by 295-29B(1) (see gates).

max_sqft.note: No fixed square-foot cap. Share cap only.

max_share_of_house.note: 'The accessory apartment shall be no more than 45% of the primary structure's total floor area.'

min_sqft.note: 'A minimum of 300 square feet of floor area shall be required.'

max_height_ft.note: 'Any structure that is accessory to a dwelling on a lot of less than three acres shall have a maximum height of one story, plus 1/2 story that is limited to nonhabitable storage, or 20 feet, whichever is more restrictive.'

max_height_stories.note: One story plus a half story of nonhabitable storage, on a lot under 3 acres.

value.where: on a lot of 3 acres or more (3 stories or 38 ft, whichever is less)
value.note: 'The maximum height for any other structure shall be three stories or 38 feet, whichever is more restrictive.'

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit in or attached to the house takes the general height, 3 stories or 38 ft.

setback_side_ft.note: 'The apartment shall meet all building setback and coverage requirements of the underlying zoning district.' Read as the district building setbacks, not the 5 ft accessory structure setback of 295-29C(2). See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: As for the side yard. District building setback.

setback_front_ft.note: 'No accessory building and no swimming pool shall be allowed in the minimum front yard.'

separation_ft.note: 'When detached from the primary residence, the apartment shall be set back a minimum of 10 feet from the primary residence.'

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'The apartment shall meet all building setback and coverage requirements of the underlying zoning district.' 295-29C(2) gives 5 ft side and rear (10 ft in C and A) for detached structures accessory to a dwelling. Read as the district setbacks for an apartment.

owner_occupancy.note: No express owner-occupancy rule. 295-96D(1)(g): 'At least a total of three off-street parking spaces are available for use by the owner-occupant and tenant.' The wording assumes an owner lives there. Ask the zoning officer.

max_adus.note: 'Only one accessory apartment shall be permitted per single-family detached residential lot.'

sale_apart_allowed.note: 'The accessory apartment shall be located on the same lot as the primary residence and cannot be subdivided or sold separately from the primary residence.'

short_term_rental_banned.note: Both short-term rental uses: 'Short-term rentals are only permitted in an existing residential building where the existing or prior approved use included a habitable dwelling unit. Addition of new rental units on the property is prohibited.' Read as barring a new apartment from short-term rental use.

spaces_required.note: The standard sets a total of 3 for the lot. The house needs 2 (295-104 table: dwelling unit 2 per dwelling unit), so the apartment adds 1.

total_on_site.note: 'At least a total of three off-street parking spaces are available for use by the owner-occupant and tenant.'

new_connection_required.note: No connection rule. On-lot sewage needs a permit first.

min_lot_sqft.note: 43,560 sq ft, 39,000 with public water, 20,000 with public water and sewer. Width 140 ft (90 ft on a 20,000 sq ft lot).
Single-family detached with public water and sewer. 39,000 with one of them, 43,560 with neither. Width 60 ft.

setback_side_ft.note: One side at least 5 ft, both sides at least 15 ft.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached with public water and sewer. 43,560 without. Width 50 ft.

setback_side_ft.note: One side at least 5 ft, both sides at least 15 ft.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached with public water and sewer. Width 40 ft.
Single-family detached with public water and sewer. Width 40 ft.

setback_side_ft.note: 15 ft without public water and sewer.
